rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with complete access to Yogosha's bug bounty platform API, built using Python with FastMCP and httpx for async HTTP operations. The implementation offers 30+ tools across seven core categories: program management for listing and retrieving bug bounty programs, asset management with full CRUD operations for program assets, vulnerability tracking and reporting with creation/update capabilities, user management for platform administration, submission handling for bug bounty reports, scope definition for program boundaries, and notification management with comment threading support. Built with Bearer token authentication, comprehensive error handling, and support for both full updates via PUT and partial updates via PATCH operations, it serves security teams managing bug bounty programs through conversational interfaces, researchers needing natural language access to platform data, and security operations workflows where AI-driven vulnerability management enhances productivity without direct API integration knowledge.
